posts.name: SiegeTurtle
posts.cooked:
Greetings! I have a few questions from some of the playable race request megathread communities on here as well as one question for myself, so I will have a few questions listed in my post.

A question from myself:

Will we ever see new pairs of faction specific playable races ever again or will the focus be on all new playable races being neutral going forward?

And now questions from a few of the playable race request megathreads!

From the Saurok Megathread:

Since we have seen Saurok travel the world (of Warcraft!) and even work with other races, are there any chances we could run into any traveling Saurok tribes and work with them against the huge Void threat or any other threats to Azeroth as a whole in the future?

From the Stonemaul Ogre Megathread:

Given that two of the three Horde Ogre clans (MU and AU Stonemaul Clans) owe the Horde a big debt for saving them and a Horde capital city is getting attacked by evil Void minions that could decimate the world (of Warcraft!), will we see any of the Horde Ogre clans appear and assist us in Midnight?

From the San’layn megathread:

Seeing as we’re uniting several Elf tribes and eventually going back to Northrend in The Last Titan, and that San’layn were former Blood Elves who were turned against their will into vampires, will we see San’layn appear in Midnight, have them be one of those Elf Tribes we unite, and then help us in both Midnight and The Last Titan?

From the Saberon Megathread:

I know we’re busy with rude Void entities threatening the world (of Warcraft!), but since it has been many years since Saberon and Botani came back to Azeroth with us during the Mag’har Orc unlock scenario and that the Botani likely haven’t been up to any good since then, will we see either of them in the near future and deal with the Botani threat growing in the Barrens?

From the Furbolg megathread:

Since the Haranir has some similar themes to Furbolgs, we go back to Northrend in The Last Titan where there are some Furbolg tribes, and ties between the Furbolg and Night Elves have likely strengthened since the Burning of Teldrassil, will we see any Furbolg tribes make an appearance in Midnight?

From the Forest Troll megathread:

Are the unlockable Amani related customization options in Midnight meant to imply that Forest Trolls are a Customization Race like Wildhammer Dwarves and Man’ari or could we still see them become a full Core or Allied race, either through the Amani, the Revantusk, or both?

From the Kelfin megathread and the Ankoan/Jinyu megathread:

Since Azshara is still out there, the Unshackled and Ankoan kinda owe the Horde and Alliance big time for saving them, and the Unshackled have been hanging out on the shores of Durotar since BfA ended, any chance we could see either groups helping out against the impending Void threat?

From the Sethrak megathread:

Seeing as Sethrak are not huge fans of Void related things, especially since that was a reason Mythrax came into being and nearly slaughtered them, will we see any of the Sethrak assist us against the impending Void army threatening the world (of Warcraft!)?

From the Ethereal megathread:

Seeing as we saved the homeworld of the Ethereals and that Xal’atath has the power of Dimensius at her command which can’t be a good thing, will we see Ethereals assist us against her and her minions?

Thank you for your time and consideration!

Epic Battleground Question:

Epic Battlegrounds consist of 66% of my playtime, (and I’m not alone) What is your goal with keeping Epic Battleground engaging and balanced?

Some of the epic battlegrounds have not been tuned for years like Isle of Conquest glaives getting 1 shot by anything looking at them.

Players mass leaving after losing the first fight so they can re-queue and fish for a win on their alt, sending a massive backfill rotation into a losing battleground where people just keep joining and leaving.

When can we expect to get cross-faction Epic Battlegrounds? It is one of the only solution to keep premade team balanced and avoid a 30man premade vs pugs.

Can we get a map update on all battlegrounds? Line of sight through the ground is getting old. We need modern battlegrounds with real objects that break LoS.

I have a few questions and most of them will relate to pvp.

-How will que times for shuffle and blitz be addressed? Currently its possible to sit for 20+ minutes in a que while it gets to 15/16 over and over.

-Is there a plan to allow players to que up for activities like dungeons and pvp while on a different character? Similar to how wave 2 plunderstorm worked, it would be very nice to be able to level up my mage in Hellfire Peninsula while having a warlock and shaman q’d up for shuffle/blitz and when a que pops it automatically logs me over to that character without having to sit in dornogal or whatever the new city will be for almost an hour.

-Are there any plans to update the pvp reward structure? Something like a battle pass from fortnite could go a long way. You could make it so that there is a reward pass for long term and short term with general rewards and seasonal. Missions for it could consist of things like “Play 2 battlegrounds today” or “win 3 arena/shuffle/blitz games this week/month” etc with a mix of casual and more hardcore ones but a way to completing the seasonal variant for even the casual players like doing 30 pvp world quests in a season giving progress and rewards like a pvp armored moonkin form or a pvp hunter pet customization option or things like spell or mount effect changes like a warriors bladestorm catches on fire.

-It’s also time for other brackets besides 3s to get meaningful rewards. With blitz and shuffle becoming very popular those brackets should have something more tangible to reach for. Doesnt have to be a gladiator mount but a nice mount and just additional rewards in between would be great.

-Can we get legion style wpvp quests back that dont allow for grouping? In tww we have world quests set up to be free for alls but they are not true ffa’s and people gang up which is fine anywhere else but if its supposed to be a ffa let it be a true ffa.

-Any plans to update old activities from prior expansions that require many players to q like Heroic Warfronts?

-Will player housing allow for recreational areas? Think like a community basketball court but the wow version, not sure what that could be. Maybe a garden and also a dueling court?

-Malefic Grasp is not fun.

-for professions, when doing an npc generated work order and getting a multicraft proc, can those go to the player instead of be sent into the void?

-Can we get tips and explanations for how the map for each blitz game works? its frustrating to be in Eye of the storm and have a rogue just waiting next to a locked base because he has no idea whats going on and think hes helping. It could be added to the loading screen or in a pvp dungeon journal.

-can we uncap conquest after its possible to get 4set

***will add more after work
